description: This Dart source file contains mock in-memory repository implementations for various entities such as users, projects, tags, and tasks, used primarily for testing or preview purposes within the project. It also provides a function to build a list of mock provider instances replacing actual Firebase-backed providers for use in preview environments.

classes.name: _MemoryStore
classes.description: A generic in-memory reactive store using broadcast streams to manage collections of items, supporting seed data, real-time updates, and CRUD operations.

classes.name: MockAuthRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of the authentication repository that maintains a fixed demo user and simulates sign-in/sign-out states using broadcast streams.

classes.name: MockProjectRepository
classes.description: A mock in-memory repository for projects, supporting stream, get, upsert, and delete operations.

classes.name: MockTagRepository
classes.description: A mock in-memory repository for tags, supporting stream, get, upsert, and delete operations.

classes.name: MockTaskRepository
classes.description: A mock in-memory repository for tasks, supporting stream, get, upsert, and delete operations.

methods.name: buildPreviewProviders
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of provider instances with mocked repositories and other dependencies for use in a preview environment.
